releases.description: Previous green StickS3 release. Aligned .3 source awaits device testing.
releases.qualification: Device-tested green .1 build: flashed and ROM-verified, menu and both buttons confirmed. It retains Compact QR, the earlier navigation/reset and captions, and the original splash typo. The aligned .3 source is build/host-tested but has not been flashed and is not offered here yet.

releases.description: Round Seeder interface with address QR and cancellable HOLD OK reset.
releases.qualification: The .9 app passed a complete Chrome USB install: signed download, factory-map check, verified and saved recovery backup, app-only write, device digest verification and restart. The same artifact also passed an independent ROM verification. Physical acceptance of the revised reset screen and a hardware restore-write test remain pending.

releases.description: Offline Confucius Say / Phoenix Link-inspired play-money game.
releases.qualification: Published stable Phoenix firmware. Release hashes, ESP32-S3 images and the 8MB partition contract were checked. Firmware publication does not itself qualify a browser USB installation on hardware.

releases.description: Hold small at zero for screen off. Small wakes; large wakes and starts.
releases.qualification: Firmware installed and read-back verified on Waveshare 1.75C. Screen-off and both wake actions confirmed on the device. Browser write testing is pending.
